Now that is something else. My lawyer said to me, "This is the strangest board I've ever seen. The president never has a board meeting or I don't know what she's doing. I think we all better leave her alone before we go to jail." The lawyer, Bill (Sousa(?)), terrific. Father Woods called him. He was a friend of Father Woods and he told him, "Please take care of Mary," and he has. He's done a lot of things he could charge me for and he's just never asked me for the money.
